repos.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.one_liner: An AI agent skill designed to research and synthesize information across financial, social, and news platforms.
bullets: Integrates with Polymarket, X, Reddit, and Hacker News for real-time data gathering.
Uses agentic workflows to synthesize grounded summaries from diverse web sources.
Ideal for market research, sentiment analysis, and tracking trending topics in finance and tech.
Built as a modular skill for AI agents to automate complex information retrieval tasks.

repos.name: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill
repos.description: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.
repos.one_liner: A machine-readable FFmpeg toolset designed specifically for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
bullets: Exposes 42 FFmpeg functions via an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
Enables agentic video editing, including captioning, reframing, and loudness normalization.
Eliminates cloud dependencies by providing a local, programmatic interface for media processing.
Allows developers to build automated video production pipelines using LLM-driven orchestration.

repos.name: google-research/paper-orchestra
repos.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent framework specifically engineered for the automated writing and research of academic papers.
bullets: Utilizes a multi-agent architecture to distribute research, drafting, and editing tasks.
Focuses on structured knowledge synthesis and rigorous academic documentation.
Provides a scalable infrastructure for automating literature reviews and technical reporting.
Useful for R&D teams looking to accelerate the documentation of complex AI or financial research.

Designed for security professionals to conduct continuous, agent-driven red teaming.
